problem_restatement: Test whether exact provider-native HIP-3 index pressure retains its direction through the latest causal book visible before routing telemetry and venue entry, without retroactively changing v51 eligibility.
analysis: Three of four exact source-native index signals reversed pressure direction by the latest causal routing-publication book. The only retained observation closed strongly positive; flipped closed observations pooled negative, while one flipped SP500 trade still won and the current flipped SPCX long remains open. This is suggestive translation risk, not sufficient evidence for a live pressure-persistence gate.

decision.next_experiment: Prospectively annotate every new exact SP500/SPCX eligible signal with retained, flipped, neutralized, or unavailable pressure at routing publication and reconcile fixed-horizon executable-BBO markouts plus final lifecycle economics.

minimum_evidence_before_change_proposal.directional_requirement: at least one long and one short in each compared state
economic_requirements: positive retained-minus-flipped separation after exact fees and modeled slippage
same conclusion at 15, 30, and 60 minute executable-BBO horizons
resolved final lifecycle costs and exits

reopen_condition: A live entry gate may be proposed only after the predeclared prospective minimum is satisfied. Otherwise retain the observation as diagnostic and do not tune thresholds on these four opened outcomes.

confidence.basis: The causal sign reversals and lifecycle arithmetic are exact, but the sample is four signals with one open lifecycle and only one retained observation.
falsifiers: Prospective retained and flipped groups do not separate after costs
The single retained winner remains the sole driver
Pressure-state attribution fails causal timestamp or source-identity reconciliation
The current flipped SPCX lifecycle closes strongly positive without unacceptable drawdown
